data_provenance: Played player-games, regular season; validation 2022-23..2023-24, holdout 2024-25..2025-26.
eval_period: Played player-games, regular season; validation 2022-23..2023-24, holdout 2024-25..2025-26.

hyperparameters.method: Ladder A-F walk-forward by season; OLS/stack weights fitted on 2016-17..2021-22 only; LightGBM refit each season on the previous five; empirical residual distribution fitted on development.

hypothesis: Role/rotation features and gradient boosting beat a shrunk EWMA (the incumbent's EWM-5 analogue).
limitations: Each rung adds real accuracy; the incumbent's rotation simulator under-projects minutes for players who play by more than 2 minutes, which propagates into every counting stat.

point.result: Validation MAE: A 5.61, B 5.20, C 5.02, D 4.99, E 4.84, F 4.85; E vs B -0.355 (95% CI -0.382 to -0.327) min. Holdout E MAE 4.76 (vs B -0.332 (95% CI -0.357 to -0.305)); incumbent sim MAE 6.17, bias -2.42 (E vs incumbent -1.427 (95% CI -1.482 to -1.377)).

question: Which pregame minutes forecast (conditional on playing) is most accurate?
